$comment: Model presets for oh-my-freebuff. Each preset maps an agent TIER to an OpenRouter model id. `omf preset <name>` rewrites the model: field of every installed agent according to its tier in agents.manifest.json. All ids are valid OpenRouter models (https://openrouter.ai/models); edit freely.

budget.description: Cheapest. Open models only. Good for high-volume, low-stakes work.

balanced.description: Default. Strong open models; good quality per dollar.

premium.description: Best quality, highest cost. Frontier models for the heavy tiers.
